change: Added a fail-closed reconciler requiring GitHub contents-at-exact-commit and git ls-tree-at-exact-commit to agree on repository path, blob SHA, and target commit before emitting a source binding.

deployment.reason: Current state prohibits application deployment attempts while Vercel provider build capacity remains exhausted.

limits: The reconciler validates supplied lookup envelopes but does not itself authenticate to GitHub or execute git ls-tree.
No GitHub Actions execution is claimed.
No Vercel deployment identity or physical Safari audibility is established.
falsification_route: Supply mismatched blob SHAs, paths, target commits, mutable lookup methods, malformed timestamps, or unsafe paths; reconciliation must fail closed.
